h:
简单但功能强大的 ComfyUI 工作流程，可将任何 2D 插图、动画框架、漫画面板或绘图转换为逼真的照片。
它使用佛罗伦萨 2自动为输入图像添加标题并将其转换为干净的提示，然后生成照片级结果通量 1 开发 + 通量还原, 一个自定义洛拉, 控制网为了获得更好保真度的姿势, 脸部细节师以获得更高保真度的面孔，以及带有轻质高档的终极标清升级器以获得额外的清晰度。

只需将 2D 图像放入，点击“生成”，只需几个步骤即可获得逼真的版本。

该工作流程包括一个 LoRA不是我创造的.
本 LoRA 的所有学分均属于其原作者：

👉 AI数字媒体机构
📎 洛拉下载： https://civitai.com/models/726732/realistic-people-photograph-flux

我实际上正在做一个v2哪里根本不需要 LoRA.

o.en:
A simple but powerful ComfyUI workflow that turns any 2D illustration, anime frame, comic panel or drawing into a realistic photo.
It usesFlorence 2to automatically caption the input image and convert it into a clean prompt, then generates a photoreal result withFlux 1 Dev + Flux Redux, a customLoRA, Control Netfor a better fidelity poses, Face Detailerfor higher fidelity faces, and a light upscale withUltimate SD Upscalerfor extra sharpness.

Just drop your 2D image in, hit generate, and get a realistic version in a few steps.

This workflow includes a LoRA thatis not created by me.
All credits for this LoRA belong to its original author:

👉 AIDigitalMediaAgency
📎 LoRA download: https://civitai.com/models/726732/realistic-people-photograph-flux

I'm actually working on av2whereno LoRA will be required at all.
